units.question: How do I make friends as an adult?
units.text: [4] Organizing groups can create new friendships and connect you with existing ones.

cited.tweet: In my early 20s I had a hard time finding new friends and social scenes. Wherever I was, I’d eventually find one group I got along with, but sometimes it took a while. / By my mid-20s I stopped *looking* for existing friend groups to join, and started *organizing* groups and events around things I care about. This creates new friends groups, and it turns out this also brings me into contact with far, far more preexisting friend groups that I want to join, because one of their members comes to my event, and maybe she brings her friends to the next one or maybe she asks me to join her roleplaying game or whatever. Now I’m part of many different overlapping communities and friend groups, enough that I can’t easily count them all./ This works for basically everyone I know who’s tried
